<!--
  Softmax and sampling laboratory: interactive markup.

  Included identically by the website module and by the deck slide, so
  there is exactly one implementation to keep correct. Hidden by default
  (inline style) until assets/js/softmax-lab.js confirms JavaScript ran and
  reveals it; if JavaScript is disabled, the browser instead renders the
  <noscript> fallback below and this block never becomes visible.

  No network dependency: prng.js and softmax-lab.js are project files,
  loaded from the site's own assets directory.
-->

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/css/interactives.css">

<div class="softmax-lab" data-softmax-lab style="display:none">
  <p><strong>Prompt:</strong> "Given the traffic data, the agency decided
  to ___ the bridge."</p>

  <div class="row">
    <label for="sm-logit-0">repair</label>
    <input type="range" id="sm-logit-0" data-logit-slider min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="2.0">
    <span class="value" data-logit-value>2.0</span>
  </div>
  <div class="row">
    <label for="sm-logit-1">monitor</label>
    <input type="range" id="sm-logit-1" data-logit-slider min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="1.0">
    <span class="value" data-logit-value>1.0</span>
  </div>
  <div class="row">
    <label for="sm-logit-2">replace</label>
    <input type="range" id="sm-logit-2" data-logit-slider min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="0.5">
    <span class="value" data-logit-value>0.5</span>
  </div>
  <div class="row">
    <label for="sm-logit-3">close</label>
    <input type="range" id="sm-logit-3" data-logit-slider min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="-0.5">
    <span class="value" data-logit-value>-0.5</span>
  </div>
  <div class="row">
    <label for="sm-logit-4">ignore</label>
    <input type="range" id="sm-logit-4" data-logit-slider min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="-3.0">
    <span class="value" data-logit-value>-3.0</span>
  </div>

  <div class="row">
    <label for="sm-temp">temperature</label>
    <input type="range" id="sm-temp" data-temp-slider min="0.1" max="2.0" step="0.05" value="1.0">
    <span class="value" data-temp-value>1.00</span>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>token</th><th>z<sub>i</sub></th><th>z<sub>i</sub>/T</th>
        <th>exp(&middot;)</th><th>p<sub>i</sub> (theory)</th><th>p<sub>i</sub> (empirical)</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody data-table-body></tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="bars" data-bars></div>

  <div class="controls">
    <button type="button" data-draw="1">Draw 1</button>
    <button type="button" data-draw="100">Draw 100</button>
    <button type="button" data-draw="1000">Draw 1000</button>
    <button type="button" data-reset>Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p class="readout" data-readout>No draws yet.</p>

  <p class="seed-box">PRNG seed (edit and press Enter for a reproducible sequence):
    <input type="text" data-seed value="42"></p>
</div>

<noscript><style>.softmax-lab { display: none !important; }</style></noscript>
<script defer src="/assets/js/prng.js"></script>
<script defer src="/assets/js/softmax-lab.js"></script>
<script defer>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-softmax-lab]").forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.display = "";
    });
  });
</script>
```
